newsitem.title: USA: COMEX copper settled higher, options play fades.
newsitem.headline: COMEX copper settled higher, options play fades.

text.p: COMEX copper nudged higher by the close on Tuesday in fairly light, choppy trade following on from the LME's options-related volatility on Monday.
"Today's action was mild - it shows the thinness of the market and the power of the options," said Richard Hirsch of Deutsche Sharps Pixley Metals.
LME options play contributed to Friday and Monday's volatility, but this has largely petered out ahead of Wednesday's options declaration in London, traders said.
"But the market may trend higher because there is a lot of good news out there," Hirsch said.
December COMEX went out 0.60 cent higher at 95.85 cents, traded 96.20 to 94.10 cents. Spot September settled 0.15 cent higher at 96.65 cents.
Volume was moderate at an estimated 8,000 lots compared to the official 14,320 lots during Friday's rally. COMEX was closed Monday for Labor Day.
LME stocks rose a nominal 500 tonnes to 275,775 tonnes on Tuesday, less than traders had expected. COMEX stocks Tuesday were unchanged at 22,104 short tons.
